q.en: "The company was accused of ___ against older applicants."
q.bn: "The company was accused of ___ against older applicants."

why.en: "Discrimination" is the noun form, needed here after "accused of".
why.bn: "Discrimination" noun form, "accused of"-এর পরে এটাই লাগবে।

q.en: Which term describes a family of parents and children only, without other relatives?
q.bn: কোন term এমন একটা family বোঝায় যেখানে শুধু parents এবং children আছে, অন্য relative নেই?

why.en: A "nuclear family" consists of parents and children only, as opposed to an extended family with other relatives.
why.bn: "Nuclear family"-তে শুধু parents আর children থাকে, extended family-র মতো অন্য relative থাকে না।

q.en: Which culture type values group harmony and family obligation over personal achievement?
q.bn: কোন culture type personal achievement-এর চেয়ে group harmony আর family obligation-কে বেশি priority দেয়?

why.en: "Collectivist culture" values group harmony and family obligation; "individualist culture" values personal achievement.
why.bn: "Collectivist culture" group harmony আর family obligation-কে priority দেয়; "individualist culture" personal achievement-কে।

q.en: "Elderly people living alone often experience social ___."
q.bn: "Elderly people living alone often experience social ___."

why.en: "Social isolation" is the fixed collocation for lacking social contact.
why.bn: "Social isolation" fixed collocation, social contact-এর অভাবের জন্য।

q.en: What has driven the shift from extended families to nuclear families in many societies?
q.bn: অনেক সমাজে extended family থেকে nuclear family-তে shift হওয়ার পেছনে কী দায়ী?

why.en: Rapid urbanisation has transformed traditional community structures, contributing to the shift toward nuclear families.
why.bn: Rapid urbanisation traditional community structure বদলে দিয়েছে, যা nuclear family-র দিকে shift-এ অবদান রাখে।
